prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). "Flutmauer", the giant concrete sea wall at the edge of the underground city, seen from above. Two large walkable areas: (1) the wide flat crest of the sea wall, a broad promenade of weathered pale-grey concrete slabs with puddles, running across the whole upper third of the image from the left edge to the right edge; its lower (southern) edge is lined with a continuous rusty iron railing; (2) below the wall, at a lower level, the "Brackbucht": a large flat bay of wet grey-brown mudflat with shallow puddles and glistening tidal rivulets, filling the lower half of the image, open and uncluttered in the middle.
The face of the sea wall between the two levels is a band of massive stained concrete with rust streaks and barnacles. Two connections lead down from the promenade to the mudflat: LEFT OF CENTER a wide concrete staircase down the wall face, and RIGHT OF CENTER a narrow sloped boat ramp with a rusty winch.
TOP LEFT: a tall old white-and-red striped lighthouse on a round concrete bastion of the wall, its lamp room glowing warm yellow, a small iron door at its base with a lantern and a little fishing gear stand (rods, buckets, a tackle box, a hand-painted fish symbol board with no letters) beside it.
TOP RIGHT, along the back (northern) side of the promenade: the "wall of freedom" - a long tall concrete parapet covered in huge, wildly colourful graffiti murals (abstract shapes, faces, stars, a heart, a wave - NO letters, NO words), paint buckets and spray cans at its foot; a small security camera on a pole at its right end - the most eye-catching spot.
CENTER-RIGHT on the railing: an old coin-operated sea telescope on a post, and a weathered wooden bench next to it facing the sea.
RIGHT EDGE of the promenade: a little tower of stacked oil barrels, and in the top-right corner the flat rooftops of harbour sheds connect to the wall crest with a short rusty catwalk bridge.
Behind the promenade along the top edge: the backs of rusty harbour warehouses and stacked shipping containers, corrugated metal, a few warm yellow windows and pink neon strips.
ON THE MUDFLAT: two old beached wooden fishing boats lying on their sides (one left, one right of center), wooden poles with hanging fishing nets, driftwood, a half-sunk crashed camera drone with a blinking red light near the waterline in the center, a pile of scrap and torn nets at the right where robot dogs make their lair (no animals drawn), a tangled drift net near the waterline on the left, paw prints in the mud.
BOTTOM EDGE: the open grey-green sea, calm, fading into thick haze at the horizon.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: TOP edge (north), center - a wide concrete ramp leading up between the warehouses toward the harbour, with a glowing cyan handrail.
Time: late evening twilight after rain, the hazy sea horizon still glowing faintly orange and violet, neon reflections in the puddles on the wall crest.
